decisions.reason: This low-pile decorative carpet is similar to the withdrawn Product C, which suggests the carpet range is being pruned, but it remains close to the core offer and is cheap to carry while overall performance meets aspirations.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet embodies the firm's craftsmanship and fine-materials positioning, and slack lets management tolerate slower sales of a premium piece.
The corner bench extends the established seating offer for residential and hospitality projects, and no shortfall signals a need for problemistic search.
This low-pile carpet is a low-cost addition near the core offer, and while the C withdrawal shows some pruning of the carpet range, there is no clear trigger to remove it.
The multi-model swivel shell chair line represents a substantial investment with broad use across residential, workplace and public interiors, so it is very likely to stay.
